_comment: Update sources for upstream-pinned add-ons, consumed by .github/workflows/update-upstream.yml. Keys are add-on directory names. Strategies: docker-tags (newest tag of a Docker Hub image matching tag_filter), github-release (latest GitHub release of a repo), ghcr-digest (pin ghcr.io image digest into vert/Dockerfile ARG). strip_prefix removes a prefix from the resolved tag before writing config.json version (omit to keep the tag verbatim, e.g. jlesage uses v-prefixed docker tags).
